messages:
Marie (AE): Customer legal needs an HSM attestation they can include in audit: HSM model + firmware, cert chain, and a cryptographic "nonce proof" showing key ops performed inside the HSM. They also want pricing for one-off attestation and quarterly attestations.

Sanjay (SalesEng): We can provide nonce-based challenge-response (signing a customer nonce with their KEK in the HSM) + signed cert chain + redacted audit snippet. We cannot provide raw key material or full firmware images. Need to confirm FIPS level.

Marie (AE): They asked for FIPS 140-2 Level 3. Also want documented import path for the CMK (how it was wrapped/imported).

Olivia (Security): Proposed deliverable: attestation letter + signed nonce response + cert chain + timeline-stamped audit excerpt. Include import path summary (KMIP/PKCS#11 steps) but no plaintext keys. Will draft wording: "Redwood performs cryptographic challenge-response attestation; customer key material is never exported."

Sanjay (SalesEng): PoC sketch for SEs: 1) customer posts nonce (base64url). 2) we call internal `hsm.sign(key_id, nonce)` 3) return { signature(b64), cert_chain_pem, audit_log_ref }. Customer verifies signature using cert chain. I'll prepare a short code snippet for the runbook.

Ben (SalesOps): Pricing: one-off attestation (NRE, compliance review, engineering time) estimated $10k-$16k. Quarterly subscription (report + minimal ops validation) ~$2.5k/quarter. On-site inspection or physical HSM audit extra. Will add as SOW line items.

Marie (AE): They also require rotation with max 15 minute disruption; prefer zero-downtime rollover. Can we promise that?

Sanjay (SalesEng): Zero-downtime achievable with shadow-key / dual-read pattern: writes to new key, reads allowed from old until cutover. Requires client-side or proxy support for dual-read window. We should not promise without a PoC for their workload — some long-lived streams could see edge cases. Recommend a 2-hr PoC to validate under their traffic.

Olivia (Security): Action items: I'll draft attestation text and attach cert thumbprints + supported API list (KMIP, PKCS#11). Sanjay: include the nonce example and expected audit excerpt. Ben: put pricing placeholders and BYOK clause into SOW. Legal-bot: please review the clause that we do not hold raw keys and that rotation scheduling is customer-responsibility unless Managed Rotation is purchased.

legal-bot: Suggested clause posted to drive: https://drive.redwood.example/s/byok-clause-v1. Text includes: "Redwood will not export customer key material. Attestations demonstrate HSM-resident operations via cryptographic proofs; they do not constitute key escrow."

Ben (SalesOps): I'll add Managed Rotation addendum option (24/7 assisted rotation) with a monthly fee line. Also adding NRE for PoC run.

Sanjay (SalesEng): PoC runbook stub I'll deliver:
```
# PoC runbook (short)
1) Customer provides nonce (base64url).
2) Run: resp = internalClient.hsm_sign(key_id=customer_kek, payload=nonce)
3) Return: { signature: base64, cert_chain_pem, audit_ref }
# Customer verifies signature with cert chain and timestamp.
```

Olivia (Security): I'll post draft attestation and cert chain reference by EOD: https://drive.redwood.example/s/attest-draft-2790. Please comment.

Marie (AE): I'll schedule a 30-min sync with the customer's security contact to walk the attestation and rotation plan. Tentative Thurs. Thanks team, keep updating this thread as single source of truth. :thumbsup:
